details.s: Curufin, also called Curufin the Crafty, was a Ñoldorin prince and the fifth of the seven Sons of Fëanor and Nerdanel. Curufin was the father of Celebrimbor, master Jewel-smith of Eregion who would later forge the three Elvish Rings of Power.
f: Prince of the Ñoldor, Lord of Himlad (with his brother Celegorm)
